title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Capacitor — 2023
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Define capacitance. Derive the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor.
questions.solution:
**Capacitance:** C = Q/V — ability to store charge per unit voltage. SI unit: Farad (F).

**Parallel plate capacitor:** Two plates of area A separated by distance d.
E = σ/ε₀ = Q/(Aε₀)
V = Ed = Qd/(Aε₀)
C = Q/V = Q/(Qd/Aε₀) = **ε₀A/d**

With dielectric (εᵣ): C = εᵣε₀A/d
questions.knowledgeNote: 1 F is very large. Typical capacitors: pF to mF range. Parallel plate: C = ε₀A/d
questions.answer: **Definition:** capacitance is the ratio of the charge stored on a conductor to the potential difference between it and earth (or between the two plates of a capacitor): **C = Q/V**. Its SI unit is the **farad (F)**: 1 F = 1 coulomb per volt. A 1 F capacitor stores 1 C of charge at 1 V. **Derivation (parallel plate):** consider two parallel plates of area A, separation d, carrying charges +Q and −Q, with surface charge density σ = Q/A. (1) **Field between the plates:** by Gauss's law, each plate produces E = σ/2ε₀ between them; the two fields add in the gap and cancel outside, so the resultant field is **E = σ/ε₀ = Q/(ε₀A)**, uniform between the plates. (2) **Potential difference:** for a uniform field, V = Ed = Qd/(ε₀A). (3) **Capacitance:** C = Q/V = Q / (Qd/ε₀A) = **C = ε₀A/d**. Capacitance increases with plate area, decreases with separation, and is filled-space independent of charge — with a dielectric (constant K) it becomes C = Kε₀A/d. **Deep point:** the derivation is a three-step ladder — Gauss gives E, E gives V, V gives C — and the final formula contains no Q or V, which is the physical statement that capacitance is a property of the geometry, not of the charge.
